05 / BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few things
worth knowing.

A little preparation makes the first conversation more useful.

Ask us on Zalo
01How should I describe the surface being labelled?＋

Tell us the material of the bottle, jar, box or product, and whether it is flat or curved, smooth or textured. Send photographs and the available area; discuss supplying a physical sample for checks before approval.

02What conditions matter when choosing a label material?＋

Describe indoor or outdoor use, exposure to water, oil, friction or cold, and expected use duration. Suitability needs to be confirmed with appropriate materials and sample checks.

03How should I prepare label dimensions and shape?＋

Provide width and height or diameter, along with the available application area. For a custom shape, include artwork or a cutting outline if available; margins are agreed during sample preparation.

04What roll details are needed for machine application?＋

Share machine or operator requirements for label exit direction, winding, core, outside diameter, label gap and quantity per roll. Specifications are confirmed for the actual equipment.

05How are small text and barcodes checked?＋

Supply accurate content, barcode files and artwork at the intended size. During sample approval, review text clarity and scan using the intended device; website photographs do not replace sample checks.

06Can I request samples and an individual quotation?＋

Use the sample or quotation request on this page. Price, minimum quantity and timing depend on materials, size, print, shape and delivery format; HotPrint discusses them after reviewing your brief.
